breakthrough: Each launch increases the value and speed of the entire portfolio
lane: Autonomous company, product, and revenue runtime
outcome: Make every product capable of feeding capabilities, users, and data advantages into other products

phases.name: Phase 1 - Build the Compounding Product Ecosystem Core

subphases.name: 1.1 Compounding Product Ecosystem Domain Model and State Plane
work: Define typed entities, capabilities, jobs, events, state transitions, and outputs required to make every product capable of feeding capabilities, users, and data advantages into other products, with explicit versions and validation at every boundary.

Implement an owned persistent state layer optimized for market signals, product experiments, customer workflows, pricing, and repeatable revenue systems; include snapshots or event history when state changes over time.
Expose create, query, update, subscribe, and delete operations through local APIs plus an SDK that never requires private cross-runtime imports.

subphases.name: 1.2 Compounding Product Ecosystem Execution Runtime
work: Build resumable workers and state machines that perform the core operation: make every product capable of feeding capabilities, users, and data advantages into other products.
Add cancellation, idempotency, bounded retries, timeouts, quotas, sandbox limits, and deterministic recovery from partial failure.
Create a local simulator that can replay success, malformed inputs, disconnection, overload, provider loss, and restart recovery.

phases.name: Phase 2 - Make Compounding Product Ecosystem Adaptive and Usable

subphases.name: 2.1 Compounding Product Ecosystem Decision and Learning Engine
work: Implement scoring, planning, prediction, search, or optimization using causal inference, forecasting, bandit optimization, agent swarms, and business simulation.
Create feedback signals from task outcomes and user corrections; update tunable behavior without silently changing hard safety limits.
Return confidence, alternatives, bottlenecks, and a concise machine-readable explanation for every important automated choice.

subphases.name: 2.2 Compounding Product Ecosystem Interaction Surface
work: Build the primary experience in the venture cockpit, experiment board, revenue map, and live customer twin, including live state, controls, errors, and recovery actions.
Add a CLI and typed client library so humans, agents, games, and third-party applications can operate the capability directly.
Stream progress and intermediate artifacts in real time so long operations remain inspectable, interruptible, and steerable.

phases.name: Phase 3 - Scale Compounding Product Ecosystem into a Breakthrough Product

subphases.name: 3.1 Compounding Product Ecosystem Offline, Edge, and Cloud Mesh
work: Implement local-only, hybrid, and cloud execution with explicit capability discovery and graceful behavior when optional peers disappear.
Add conflict-safe synchronization, workload placement, caching, backpressure, and failover across devices or nodes where the feature benefits from distribution.
Benchmark latency, throughput, memory, energy, network transfer, and cost; make the scheduler choose the best execution mode from measured constraints.

subphases.name: 3.2 Compounding Product Ecosystem Signature Breakthrough
work: Implement the differentiating behavior: Each launch increases the value and speed of the entire portfolio. Ship it as an opt-in executable mode, not a mockup.
Run adversarial, load, privacy, misuse, degraded-network, and recovery tests against the novel behavior; block unsafe automatic actions.
Package the feature as an independently installable capability with a live demo, sample integration, metrics endpoint, and rollback-safe release artifact.
